# FULL_REPOSITORY_STATIC_AUDIT

**Task:** AUD-001 (Production Readiness pack)
**Baseline:** `main` at `8d3184e5af7ddffea5341aaf7ea8676ea1962451`
**Method:** generated by reading current code (not older status docs), 22 July 2026.
**Scope:** static inventory + honest status + risks. No code changed.

> This audit supersedes the narrative `02_CURRENT_REPOSITORY_AUDIT.md` for the
> file/subsystem-level view. Where a legacy tracker disagrees with this file,
> this file — being derived from committed code — is authoritative until the
> owner re-locks the product contract (GOV-001).

## Verification vocabulary (per pack)

| Level | Meaning as used below |
|---|---|
| `NOT_STARTED` | No implementing code found. |
| `IMPLEMENTED` | Code exists and compiles into the app target; no independent verification. |
| `UNIT_VERIFIED` | Covered by a test that an executable target can run. **Currently unreachable — see Tests/CI.** |
| `INTEGRATION_VERIFIED` | Exercised end-to-end in-app or via a runnable gate (e.g. ProjectDelta eval), observed to work. |
| `REAL_DATA_VERIFIED` | Exercised against the owner's real corpus (`~/Downloads/Mail`, 91 MB mbox) this session and observed correct. |
| `RELEASE_VERIFIED` | Signed, clean-machine, owner-accepted. **Not reached for any subsystem.** |
| `DEFERRED` | Intentionally out of v1 scope. |
| `BLOCKED` | Cannot progress without an external gate (closed Xcode, owner decision, license). |

Two structural caveats colour every status below:

1. **No executable test target exists** (`project.pbxproj` has 0 references to
   `KalsmritikoshTests`, yet 49 test files sit in `KalsmritikoshTests/`). So
   nothing can currently be `UNIT_VERIFIED`; the highest a unit-only item can
   reach is `IMPLEMENTED`. This is the TST-001 blocker.
2. **A build passing is never release verification** (pack rule). Build-green is
   treated as necessary, not sufficient.

## 2. Subsystem inventory & honest status

### Ingestion — `REAL_DATA_VERIFIED`
- Structural-first pipeline: `IngestCoordinator` → `StructuralParserRegistry` →
  EvidenceBlock → chunk (`evidence_block_id` link) → model-aware embeddings.
- Verified this session against the real 91 MB `Sent.mbox`: 526/526 messages,
  99.3% unique attachments, **0 failures**, chunk→block link 99.7%, embeddings 100%.
- Two-pass ingest (embeddings deferred to background), OCR triage, magic-byte
  sniffing for extensionless attachments, MIME-routed email attachments.
- **Gaps:** no *atomic per-file transaction with collected failures* (PI.2 pending)
  and no *durable resumable run-state machine* (PI.3 pending). Pause/Stop exists
  (`IngestControl`) but is cooperative-checkpoint, not crash-atomic.

### Parsers / format coverage — `REAL_DATA_VERIFIED` (fidelity), `IMPLEMENTED` (matrix honesty)
- 17 registered parsers covering text, DOCX/DOC, CSV, XLSX/XLS(BIFF8), PPTX, EPUB,
  RTF, ODT/ODS, EML/MBOX/EMLX, PDF (PDFKit+Vision), image (Vision OCR).
- All 20 advertised formats verified for marker fidelity on synthetic fixtures and
  on real mbox attachments this session.
- **Gaps:** FULL/PARTIAL/PRESERVED-ONLY classification is not yet surfaced as a
  single honest coverage report per source (P4.4/ING-001). Audio/video is a
  deliberate WhisperKit stub + media-deferred skip — status is **DEFERRED by design**,
  but `SUPPORTED_FORMATS_V1.md` still over-claims and must be corrected (GOV-001).

### Storage / Schema — `INTEGRATION_VERIFIED`
- Single `actor Database` (raw sqlite3 C-API); repositories only. 69 tables, v54.
- `SchemaMigrations` asserts a gap-free `1...54` sequence and self-heals a stale
  `user_version` when the full schema is already applied (guards the re-migration brick).
- **Gaps:** migration consistency is asserted in code but **not covered by a runnable
  migration test** (blocked on TST-001). No forward/backward fault-injection proof.

### Retrieval — `IMPLEMENTED` / partial `INTEGRATION_VERIFIED`  ⚠ highest product risk
- `HybridRetriever` multi-channel (memory→timeline→entity→metadata→summary→graph→
  vector) with RRF fusion, per-source diversify, independent vector channel,
  deterministic `TableQueryEngine` fast path.
- ProjectDelta gold gate: recall 1.00, cite-precision 1.00 (no regression).
- **On real data, still surfaces wrong documents for 2 of 3 probed questions**
  (PhonePe receipt image; dual-dense "where worked"). The current authority
  mechanism is a **density heuristic + first-chunk injection** in `HybridRetriever`
  — explicitly flagged by the pack (§7) as a prohibited hard-coded boost to be
  **replaced** by a query-conditioned DocumentFitness channel (RET-001/RET-003).
- **Status honestly: NOT release-ready.** This is the decisive quality lever.

### Brain / synthesis / reconstruction — `IMPLEMENTED`
- `MasterBrain`, `AnswerSynthesizer`, reranker ladder (CoreML cross-encoder tier),
  `ConfidenceEngine`, `EvidenceVerifier`, investigation planner/runner, reasoning trace.
- Minimum-LLM budget in place (ordinary question ≈ 1 generative call).
- **Gaps:** deterministic reconstruction outline is not *guaranteed* to constrain
  narrative before generation; per-sentence verification (entities/date/amount/
  causal-wording/citation) is incomplete (RET/RECON workstream D). A
  `"Subjects in scope:"` debug string leaks into some answer bodies.

### Experts — `IMPLEMENTED`
- 7 stateless experts (Email, Financial, Legal, OCR, Project, Reasoning, Research,
  Timeline) behind capability specs; read the ledger at question time; grep-guard clean.
- **Gaps:** end-to-end per-expert claim–evidence enforcement not independently verified.

### Routing / Providers / model gating — `REAL_DATA_VERIFIED`
- Capability discipline intact (no model names outside Routing/Providers).
- Providers: FoundationModels, Ollama (discovery/installer/advisor/provider),
  Llama.cpp seam, MLX seam, CoreML embedder, Cloud (release-gated off).
- **Strict device-fit gate verified live:** mixtral (~39 GB working set) is excluded
  even if pinned; qwen2.5:7b resolves and answers in ~35–60 s on the 16 GB device.
- **Gaps:** Llama.cpp/MLX are intentional stubs/seams (P1.2 pending); bundled-embedder
  packaging + re-embedding migration (P6.2) pending; supported-OS/native-runtime
  contract is an **owner decision (GOV-001)**.

### Embeddings / Vector — `IMPLEMENTED` (in-memory), scale `NOT_STARTED`
- BGE-small 384-dim, model-aware storage; NLEmbedder path; `HNSWVectorIndex`
  in-memory + `SQLiteVectorStore`; embedding cache.
- **Gaps:** disk-backed / sharded ANN for advertised scale is **NOT_STARTED**
  (P9.3). NLEmbedder cold-start ~60 s is the real vectorization bottleneck.
  Any 100 GB / 1 TB claim is **unproven** and prohibited until measured.

### EvalKit — `INTEGRATION_VERIFIED` (fixture) / `IMPLEMENTED` (real gate)
- Gold gate, 60-question retrieval eval, real-data probe, release-readiness scorer,
  error-analysis classifier, narrative eval.
- **Gaps:** eval runs in-app, not under a CI test target; not a mandatory merge gate
  (CI-001 blocked on TST-001).

### Personas / Work products / Export — `IMPLEMENTED`
- Persona templates (legal/investigation/journalism/research/individual), work cards,
  cross-doc matrix, connection finder, deterministic work products, citation renderer,
  export manifest, verifiable receipt.
- **Gaps:** end-to-end persona *job completion* not verified; no versioned analytical
  projection engine (Workbench/DataLab) — that backend is **NOT_STARTED** greenfield
  (Workstream E).

### Privacy / Security / Redaction — `IMPLEMENTED`, redaction `DEFERRED`
- `PrivacyGate` filters cloud providers out of capability resolution; release-only
  provider gating; privacy manifest; no network call outside Routing/Providers (verified).
- **Gaps:** F7 PII/redaction epic is **DEFERRED** (safety-critical, blind-run-test-gated).
  Visual/binary redaction verification incomplete; sensitive-logging audit not done.

### Background services — `IMPLEMENTED`
- `BackgroundService` + `SystemActivity.isIdle` (HID-idle) gating; distiller, maturation
  notifier, Tier3 escalator, worker pools, resource lanes, LLM call counters.
- Idle-gated; maintenance defaults **Off**. **Gap:** priority scheduling / durability (P9.1).

### Tests / CI — `BLOCKED`
- 49 test files exist; **0** are in an executable target. No CI. Nothing verifiable
  through automation. **Root blocker (TST-001) requires Xcode closed to edit pbxproj.**

## 3. Generative-call-site inventory (LLM discipline)

33 raw `generate`/`generateStream` sites across Knowledge (12), Experts (8),
Brain (6), UI (2), Routing (2), Ingestion (2), Core (1).

- **Action for later tasks:** the 2 Ingestion sites must be confirmed to contain **no
  ingest-time generation** on the hot path (pack §7 prohibits LLM extraction over
  every chunk/entity at ingest). The Knowledge sites (summaries/memory) must be
  confirmed budgeted and not "regenerate global summaries after every change."
  This audit flags them for EV-001/ING-001 review; it does not modify them.

## 4. Highest-risk gaps (code-grounded, priority order)

1. **Retrieval authority is a heuristic patch, not query-conditioned fitness** —
   the density boost in `HybridRetriever` fixes single examples and still returns
   wrong documents on real data. (RET-001 → RET-003)
2. **No executable test target / CI** — the entire 49-file corpus is inert; nothing
   is machine-verifiable. (TST-001 → CI-001, BLOCKED on closed Xcode)
3. **Governance docs contradict shipped reality** — SHIP_DECISIONS/SUPPORTED_FORMATS/
   SHIPPING disagree on model strategy, formats, distribution. (GOV-001, owner-gated)
4. **Source/version authority spread across layers** — KnowledgeObjects/chunks not yet
   demoted to pure projections of SourceDocument/Version/EvidenceBlock. (EV-001)
5. **Ingest not crash-atomic / not durably resumable.** (PI.2, PI.3 / ING-001)
6. **Reconstruction outline doesn't provably gate narrative; sentence verification
   incomplete.** (Workstream D)
7. **No Workbench/DataLab analytical backend.** (Workstream E, greenfield)
8. **Redaction proof incomplete.** (F7, DEFERRED but release-blocking)
9. **Scale is memory-bound; large-corpus claims unproven.** (P9.3)
10. **No clean-machine / signed / owner-accepted release run.** (RELEASE_VERIFIED unreached)

## 5. Honest maturity estimate

```text
architecture direction          strong
core evidence implementation    advanced
ingestion & parsing             real-data verified
model safety/device-fit         real-data verified
retrieval authority             heuristic — not release ready   ← decisive gap
integration verification (CI)   blocked (no test target)
reconstruction verification     incomplete
workbench/datalab               not started
redaction proof                 deferred
scale beyond memory             not started
release operations              not proven
```

**Bottom line:** the database and ingestion are built to a high, real-data-verified
standard and the model layer is safe. Release readiness is gated by, in order:
governance truth (GOV-001), an executable test/CI spine (TST-001/CI-001), and the
query-conditioned retrieval-authority rewrite (RET-001/RET-003) — not by missing
ingestion or model work.
